description: Single, interest and dividends, standard deduction
Joint, two children, large federal tax deduction, itemizes on Alabama only
working: Federal: AGI 250,000 - 32,200 = 217,800; ordinary 87,800 -> 2,480 + 12% x 63,000 = 10,040; gains 130,000: 11,100 at 0% (to 98,900), 118,900 x 15% = 17,835; regular tax 27,875 less child tax credit 2 x 2,200 = 23,475. NIIT: MAGI not above 250,000. Federal itemized 5,000 + ~10,266 AL tax + 8,000 + 3,000 - 1,250 floor = ~25,016 < 32,200, so federal standard. Alabama: AGI 250,000; federal tax deduction 23,475; Schedule A = 5,000 property tax + 8,000 mortgage interest + 3,000 gifts = 16,000 > 5,000 standard, so itemize 16,000 (no wages, so no FICA line); exemptions 3,000 (MFJ) + 2 dependents x 300 (AGI over 100,000) = 3,600. Taxable = 250,000 - 23,475 - 16,000 - 3,600 = 206,925. Tax (joint) = 2% x 1,000 = 20 + 4% x 5,000 = 200 + 5% x 200,925 = 10,046.25 -> 10,266.25.
